purpose: Deterministic (no LLM) comparison of fixed rules vs strict equal-weight buy-and-hold on four names. Not evidence about the AI analyst layer.
selection_policy: Four names the owner asked about after the 2026-11-05 selloff; all are current mega-cap survivors, so strict hold is expected to be strong (survivorship bias disclosed).
rules: One run per arm; no parameter changes after seeing results.
Results reported whether or not they beat strict hold.
No LLM/analyst layer involved; AI-only arm not run here.
